objectives.description: Recite selected short surahs (Al-Fatiha, Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas, Al-Asr) with correct pronunciation and tajweed
Identify and apply basic rules of tajweed including madd, ghunnah, idgham, and ikhfa in recitation
Translate and explain the meanings of selected Qur'anic surahs and apply their teachings to daily life
Describe the importance of the Qur'an as the primary source of guidance for Muslims
Identify selected hadith of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) and explain their moral and practical relevance
Distinguish between authentic (sahih) and weak hadith and explain the importance of hadith sciences
Apply prophetic teachings on honesty, cleanliness, respect for elders, and good neighbourliness in daily conduct

subStrands.name: Prophets, Early Islam, and Islam in Nigeria

objectives.description: Narrate the lives and missions of selected prophets of Allah including Ibrahim, Musa, Isa, and Muhammad (SAW)
Describe the early history of Islam, the Hijrah, and the establishment of the Muslim community in Medina
Explain the spread of Islam in West Africa and its introduction to northern Nigeria through trans-Saharan trade
Describe the Sokoto Jihad led by Usman Dan Fodio and its impact on Islam in Nigeria
Identify notable Islamic scholars and leaders in Nigeria and their contributions to education and governance

subStrands.name: Pillars of Islam and Moral Conduct

objectives.description: Explain the Five Pillars of Islam (Shahadah, Salat, Zakat, Sawm, Hajj) and their significance for Muslim life
Demonstrate correct performance of wudu (ablution) and the five daily prayers with their intentions and postures
Explain the importance of fasting in Ramadan (Sawm), its spiritual benefits, and rules of the fast
Describe Islamic values of honesty, justice, compassion, and modesty and how they guide a Muslim's interaction with others
Identify Islamic festivals (Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha) and explain their significance and modes of celebration
